claim: Try it with sample data opens the water demo in one click at 65% settling, 65% filter speed, and 60% disinfectant without changing real data.
sandbox: Fresh 390x844 browser clicks the home action once; asserts banner and seeded control in the first viewport, reset, ?demo=1, demo-only session storage, an untouched real key, and canonical rejection of imported demo settings.

claim: Leave demo and clear sample removes demo data without changing real data.
sandbox: Fresh demo context changes sample data, leaves demo, and asserts the real URL, hidden banner, empty demo namespace, and untouched real key.
Fresh contexts open all three simulations and assert that no payment, account, or sign-in gate appears.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh demo context waits for service-worker control, goes offline, reloads, and asserts the seeded control and value.

claim: There are no accounts, analytics, cookies, or saved profiles.
sandbox: Fresh browser captures the demo and all system requests; rejects other origins, tracking endpoints, cookies, profile storage, account UI, WebSockets, and event streams.

claim: No account; settings stay in the URL.
sandbox: Fresh real-mode context changes a control, copies the link, asserts only system settings are present, and reopens the copied value.

claim: Each simulation has three controls, five stages, three live results, a fault, and a worker’s job note.
sandbox: Fresh contexts exercise every system: exact counts, reactive results, reachable target, unlocked fault, changed fault outcome, simplification note, and non-empty job note.
Fresh water simulation focuses a native range input and verifies ArrowRight changes its value.

claim: If your device reduces motion, flow lines stay still and screen changes do not animate.
sandbox: Fresh reduced-motion context inspects every element and pseudo-element for animation and transition duration, plus instant scroll behavior.

claim: Each simulation has a link you can copy and reopen.
sandbox: Fresh browser checks product-first titles plus raw and executed metadata, route focus, announcements, Back, and Forward; then each system changes one setting, copies its URL, and reopens that value in a separate page.

claim: Watch mode can pause and stops after four captions.
sandbox: Fresh water route starts Watch mode, pauses it, resumes it, advances time, and asserts caption four and stopped state.

claim: The generated panorama is original to this product, with its source prompt and generation record included.
sandbox: Repository check asserts the retained source image, prompt text, design generation record, and on-page disclosure.

claim: The production build creates the static site in dist, with index.html at its root.
sandbox: Clean repository build asserts dist/index.html, the hashed asset directory, and hosting configuration.

claim: The included hosting file adds security rules and a branded page for missing links.
sandbox: Production preview requests an unknown route and asserts status 404, branded content, CSP, and nosniff headers.

claim: The project installs, tests, and builds on Node.js 20.19+ (20.x) and 22.12+.
sandbox: Three clean temporary source copies run npm ci, npm test, and npm run build at both documented boundaries (Node.js 20.19.0 and 22.12.0) and the latest Node.js 24 LTS release; the test also asserts the engine range.
